71461-the-story-of-fifine.title: Story Of Fifine
71461-the-story-of-fifine.creator: Bernard Capes
71461-the-story-of-fifine.description: A book by Bernard Capes. But the little island is too small for me; or I am too big for it. There is not my peer there in the art of modelling; not a piece of native sculpture that I should like to acknowledge for my own.

arxiv-2003-04738.title: EKOR strata on Shimura varieties with parahoric reduction
arxiv-2003-04738.creator: Jens Hesse
arxiv-2003-04738.description: Abstract We investigate the geometry of the special fiber of the integral model of a Shimura variety with parahoric level at a given prime place. To be more precise, we deal with the EKOR stratification which interpolates between the Ekedahl-Oort and Kottwitz-Rapoport stratifications.

arxiv-2009-09340.title: The binary Gold function and its c c -boomerang connectivity table
arxiv-2009-09340.creator: Sartaj Ul Hasan, Mohit Pal, Pantelimon Stănică
arxiv-2009-09340.description: Abstract . Here, we give a complete description of the c c -Boomerang Connectivity Table for the Gold function over finite fields of even characteristic, by using double Weil sums. In the process we generalize a result of Boura and Canteaut (IACR Trans. Symmetric Cryptol. 2018(3) : 290-310, 2018) for the classical boomerang uniformity.

arxiv-2012-09704.title: Probing sub-eV Dark Matter decays with PTOLEMY
arxiv-2012-09704.creator: and Anastasia Sokolenko
arxiv-2012-09704.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by and Anastasia Sokolenko. When the Dark Matter mass is below the eV-scale, its cosmological occupation number exceeds the ones of photons from the cosmic microwave background as well as of relic neutrinos. If such Dark Matter decays to pairs of neutrinos, it implies that experiments that seek the detection of the cosmic neutrino background may as well be sensitive to this additional form of “dark radiation”.

arxiv-2111-09544.title: C-OPH: Improving the Accuracy of One Permutation Hashing (OPH) with Circulant Permutations
arxiv-2111-09544.creator: Xiaoyun Li, Ping Li
arxiv-2111-09544.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Xiaoyun Li, Ping Li. Minwise hashing (MinHash) is a classical method for efficiently estimating the Jaccrad similarity in massive binary (0/1) data. To generate K K hash values for each data vector, the standard theory of MinHash requires K K independent permutations. Interestingly, the recent work on “circulant MinHash” (C-MinHash) ( Li and Li 2021b ) has shown that merely two permutations are needed.

arxiv-2207-04332.title: Hadron-hadron collision mode in ReneSANCe-v1.3.0 Journal: Computer Physics Communications
arxiv-2207-04332.creator: Serge Bondarenko, Yahor Dydyshka, Lidia Kalinovskaya, Renat Sadykov, Vitaly Yermolchyk
arxiv-2207-04332.description: Abstract We report an implementation of the hadron-hadron ( p ​ p pp and p ​ p ¯ p\bar{p} ) collision mode to the Monte Carlo event generator ReneSANCe — the code that was previously developed for e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} collisions.

arxiv-2304-00657.creator: Greta Marino, Sunra Mosconi
arxiv-2304-00657.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Greta Marino, Sunra Mosconi. We prove local Lipschitz regularity for local minimisers of W 1 , 1 ​ ( Ω ) ∋ v ↦ ∫ Ω F ⁡ ( D ​ v ) ​ 𝑑 x W^{1,1}(\Omega)\ni v\mapsto\int_{\Omega}F(Dv)\,dx where Ω ⊆ ℝ N \Omega\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{N} , N ≥ 2 N\geq 2 and F : ℝ N → ℝ F:\mathbb{R}^{N}\to\mathbb{R} is a quasiuniformly convex integrand in the sense of Kovalev and Maldonado [ 30 ] , i.

arxiv-2305-10051.title: Finding an ϵ \epsilon -Close Minimal Variation of Parameters in Bayesian Networks
arxiv-2305-10051.creator: Bahare Salmani, Joost-Pieter Katoen
arxiv-2305-10051.description: Abstract This paper addresses the ϵ \epsilon -close parameter tuning problem for Bayesian networks (BNs): find a minimal ϵ \epsilon -close amendment of probability entries in a given set of (rows in) conditional probability tables that make a given quantitative constraint on the BN valid.

arxiv-2310-07471.title: The Implications of Decentralization in Blockchained Federated Learning: Evaluating the Impact of Model Staleness and Inconsistencies
arxiv-2310-07471.creator: Francesc Wilhelmi ⋆ , Nima Afraz ♯ , Elia Guerra ♭ , and Paolo Dini ♭
arxiv-2310-07471.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Francesc Wilhelmi ⋆ , Nima Afraz ♯ , Elia Guerra ♭ , and Paolo Dini ♭. Blockchain promises to enhance distributed machine learning (ML) approaches such as federated learning (FL) by providing further decentralization, security, immutability, and trust, which are key properties for enabling collaborative intelligence in next-generation applications.

arxiv-2404-01176.title: Using Chao’s Estimator as a Stopping Criterion for Technology-Assisted Review
arxiv-2404-01176.creator: M.P. Bron
arxiv-2404-01176.description: Abstract Technology-Assisted Review (TAR) aims to reduce the human effort required for screening processes such as abstract screening for systematic literature reviews. Human reviewers label documents as relevant or irrelevant during this process, while the system incrementally updates a prediction model based on the reviewers’ previous decisions.

arxiv-2407-01122.title: Calibrated Large Language Models for Binary Question Answering
arxiv-2407-01122.creator: Patrizio Giovannotti, Alex Gammerman
arxiv-2407-01122.description: Abstract Quantifying the uncertainty of predictions made by large language models (LLMs) in binary text classification tasks remains a challenge. Calibration, in the context of LLMs, refers to the alignment between the model’s predicted probabilities and the actual correctness of its predictions. A well-calibrated model should produce probabilities that accurately reflect the likelihood of its predictions being correct.

arxiv-2407-20295.title: Warped multifidelity Gaussian processes for data fusion of skewed environmental data
arxiv-2407-20295.creator: Pietro Colombo, Claire Miller, Xiaochen Yang, Ruth O’Donnell, Paolo Maranzano
arxiv-2407-20295.description: Abstract Understanding the dynamics of climate variables is paramount for numerous sectors, like energy and environmental monitoring. This study focuses on the critical need for a precise mapping of environmental variables for national or regional monitoring networks, a task notably challenging when dealing with skewed data.

arxiv-2411-04003.title: Learning Aggregate Queries Defined by First-Order Logic with Counting
arxiv-2411-04003.creator: Steffen van Bergerem, Nicole Schweikardt
arxiv-2411-04003.description: Abstract In the logical framework introduced by Grohe and Turán (TOCS 2004) for Boolean classification problems, the instances to classify are tuples from a logical structure, and Boolean classifiers are described by parametric models based on logical formulas. This is a specific scenario for supervised passive learning, where classifiers should be learned based on labelled examples.

arxiv-2504-08105.title: Energy reduction for Fourth order Willmore energy
arxiv-2504-08105.creator: Nan Wu, Zetian Yan
arxiv-2504-08105.description: Abstract . We introduce a fourth-order Willmore-type problem for closed four-dimensional submanifolds immersed in ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} and establish a connected sum energy reduction for the general fourth-order Willmore energy, analogous to the seminal result of Bauer and Kuwert [ 2 ] . 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 30C70, 49Q10, 58E15, 30C70 1.

arxiv-2508-16515.title: Comparative Analysis of UAV Path Planning Algorithms for Efficient Navigation in Urban 3D Environments
arxiv-2508-16515.creator: 1 st Hichem Cheriet, 2 nd Khellat Kihel Badra, 3 rd Chouraqui Samira
arxiv-2508-16515.description: Abstract The most crucial challenges for UAVs are planning paths and avoiding obstacles in their way. In recent years, a wide variety of path-planning algorithms have been developed. These algorithms have successfully solved path-planning problems; however, they suffer from multiple challenges and limitations.

arxiv-2601-09650.title: Geometric obstructions for ξ \xi -fillings of 3-manifolds
arxiv-2601-09650.creator: Daniel Galvin, Peter Teichner, Simona Veselá
arxiv-2601-09650.description: Abstract . We consider the realisation problem for normal 1-types of 4-manifolds with a given boundary. More precisely, given a normal 1-type ξ \xi and closed 3-dimensional ξ \xi -manifold Y Y , does there exist a compact 4-dimensional ξ \xi -manifold with boundary Y Y ?

plos-pone-0005712.creator: Simon D. Donner
plos-pone-0005712.description: PLOS ONE research article. Periods of anomalously warm ocean temperatures can lead to mass coral bleaching. Past studies have concluded that anthropogenic climate change may rapidly increase the frequency of these thermal stress events, leading to declines in coral cover, shifts in the composition of coral

pmc-10545687.title: Time-series analysis of transcriptomic changes due to permethrin exposure reveals that Aedes aegypti undergoes detoxification metabolism over 24 h
pmc-10545687.creator: Lindsey K. Mack, Geoffrey M. Attardo
pmc-10545687.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Insecticide resistance is a multifaceted response and an issue across taxa. Aedes aegypti, the mosquito that vectors Zika, dengue, chikungunya, and yellow fever, demonstrates high levels of pyrethroid resistance across the globe, presenting a challenge to public health officials. To examine the transcriptomic shifts across time after exposure to permethrin, a 3’Tag-Seq analysis was employed on samples 6, 10, and 24 h after exposure along with controls. Differential expression analysis revealed significant shifts in detoxifying enzymes and various energy-producing metabolic processes.

pmc-10613241.title: Neuroprotective effects of polyacrylic acid (PAA) conjugated cerium oxide against hydrogen peroxide- and 6-OHDA-induced SH-SY5Y cell damage
pmc-10613241.creator: Rugmani Meenambal, Tomasz Kruk, Jacek Gurgul, Piotr Warszyński, Danuta Jantas
pmc-10613241.description: Cerium oxide nanoparticles have been widely investigated against neurodegenerative diseases due to their antioxidant properties that aid in quenching reactive oxygen species. In this study, polyacrylic acid conjugated cerium oxide (PAA-CeO) nanoparticles were synthesized in a 50–60 nm size range with a zeta potential of − 35 mV.

pmc-10632529.title: Determining suitable surfactant concentration ranges to avoid protein unfolding in pharmaceutical formulations using UV analysis
pmc-10632529.creator: Laura J Waters, Joseph Whiteley, William Small, Steve Mellor
pmc-10632529.description: Protein stability is fundamental to maintain pharmaceutical efficacy in the nascent field of biologics. One particular property that is essential for therapeutic effect is retention of the folded 3-dimensional conformation, i.e. once unfolding has occurred the biologic is often rendered inactive. In this work we propose a modified form of a recently published UV spectroscopic method that identifies protein unfolding.

pmc-11366759.title: Suppression of ferroptosis by vitamin A or radical-trapping antioxidants is essential for neuronal development
pmc-11366759.creator: Juliane Tschuck, Vidya Padmanabhan Nair, Ana Galhoz, Carole Zaratiegui, Hin-Man Tai, Gabriele Ciceri, Ina Rothenaigner, Jason Tchieu, Brent R. Stockwell, Lorenz Studer, Daphne S. Cabianca, Michael P. Menden, Michelle Vincendeau, Kamyar Hadian
pmc-11366759.description: The development of functional neurons is a complex orchestration of multiple signaling pathways controlling cell proliferation and differentiation. Because the balance of antioxidants is important for neuronal survival and development, we hypothesized that ferroptosis must be suppressed to gain neurons.

pmc-11507154.title: Mapping Guaranteed Positive Secret Key Rates for Continuous Variable Quantum Key Distribution
pmc-11507154.creator: Mikhael T Sayat, Oliver Thearle, Biveen Shajilal, Sebastian P Kish, Ping Koy Lam, Nicholas J Rattenbury, John E Cater, Gregg Jaeger
pmc-11507154.description: The standard way to measure the performance of existing continuous variable quantum key distribution (CVQKD) protocols is by using the achievable secret key rate (SKR) with respect to one parameter while keeping all other parameters constant. However, this atomistic method requires many individual parameter analyses while overlooking the co-dependence of other parameters.

pmc-12510038.title: Multifunctional nanoplatform as nano-inducer of ferroptosis for targeted recognition and imaging-guided therapy of metastatic prostate cancer
pmc-12510038.creator: Liang He, Hao Liang, Jixue Wang, Annan Liu, Lei Li, Ji Lu, Ze Wang, Andrew K Whittaker, Quan Lin
pmc-12510038.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Metastasis prostate cancer (PCa) precision detection and effective treatment remain significant challenge in clinic. Ferroptosis brought promising therapeutic strategy for the treatment of metastatic PCa, effectively inducing ferroptosis in PCa cells represents key to improve therapeutic efficacy. Herein, we developed a multifunctional nanoplatform Fe/Au nanodots-bombesin (FGN-BBN) as the ferroptosis nano-inducer to generate large amount of ROS to induce ferroptosis through an “open-source throttling” strategy for targeted imaging-guided therapy of metastatic PCa.

pmc-12563520.title: Asiatic Acid from Centella asiatica as a Potent EGFR Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitor with Anticancer Activity in NSCLC Cells Harboring Wild-Type and T790M-Mutated EGFR
pmc-12563520.creator: Chaiwat Monmai, Sahachai Sabuakham, Wachirachai Pabuprapap, Waraluck Chaichompoo, Apichart Suksamrarn, Panupong Mahalapbutr, Juei-Tang Cheng
pmc-12563520.description: Lung cancer is a leading cause of cancer mortality worldwide. Targeted therapies with epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs) represent a significant advance in the management of lung cancer. However, their long-term efficacy is often limited by acquired resistance, particularly due to the T790M mutation, highlighting the need for novel EGFR-TKIs.

pmc-12644764.title: Mindfulness and school adaptation among Chinese college students: examining the mediating effects of psychological resilience and self-harmony
pmc-12644764.creator: Lianchao An, Chuanjuan Sun, Baiyang Liu, Zhen Xuan, Fei Liu
pmc-12644764.description: Mindfulness is critical for physical and mental well-being, yet its role in enhancing college students’ school adaptation (SA) remains underinvestigated to date. Consequently, this study aims to examine the relationship between mindfulness, psychological resilience (PR), self-harmony, and college students’ SA. A total of 312 students were randomly selected from three universities in Heilongjiang and Henan provinces for assessment.

pmc-13386041.title: Mixed-methods evaluation protocol for the Now & Next programme: a codesigned, family-centred peer-led caregiver support programme
pmc-13386041.creator: Sara Cibralic, Sylvana Mahmic, Anoo Bhopti, Margaret L. Kern, Lulu Barker, Prasadhini De Silva, Eram Afroze, Kylie Aekins, Valsamma Eapen
pmc-13386041.description: IntroductionAs the rates of child developmental delay and disability (referred onwards as developmental needs) increase globally, so does the number of caregivers caring for a child with developmental needs. It is well known that caring for a child with disability and/or delay leads to many challenges.

pmc-13555869.title: Polystyrene microplastics impair sheep spermatogenesis by disrupting rumen microbiota-derived butyrate signaling
pmc-13555869.creator: Juanjuan Song, Keyan Ma, Xingcai Qi, Dengpan Li, Xingxu Zhao, Youji Ma
pmc-13555869.description: BackgroundMicroplastics are emerging environmental contaminants with male reproductive toxicity; however, their effects on ruminants and underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood.ResultsIn this study, male Hu lambs were exposed to dietary polystyrene microplastics (PS-MPs) at 0, 75, and 150 mg/kg diet for 120 d, followed by a 180-d recovery period.
